recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-19303 unless a future editorial review wants broader wording improvements unrelated to the published typo request.
issue_request: FHIR-19303 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR-core versioning page, auto-approved for STU3, asking to correct seven typos in section 2.8: lower-case "fhir", misspelled "CapabilityStatemet", possessive "it's", "resourcs", duplicated "be be", "maange", and "aspeect".
initial_application: No source commit with an explicit FHIR-19303 subject or trailer was found. The relevant page was nevertheless corrected in normal source history: commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e changed source/versioning.html for "many typo fixes" on 2018-10-10 and fixed six issue-listed strings, while later QA commit dad7cf37c75822c352509e1c2e8d050408d0be18 changed "it's CapabilityStatement" to "its CapabilityStatement".
additional_context: source/versioning.html remains an active built source page: it declares "Managing Multiple FHIR Versions", is listed in source/hierarchy.xml, and is linked from current module/documentation pages. Quoted Jira-key searches found no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence records and no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already has the requested corrections: "FHIR", "CapabilityStatement", "its CapabilityStatement", "resources", single "be applicable", "manage", and "aspect" all appear correctly, and the obsolete typo strings are absent.
